note: What a server sends to say a unit is attacking the champion a client holds. It carries the layout TargetUnit carries and draws nothing: a client marks the attacker and does no more, and only where the target names the champion it holds and the two are on different sides. Nothing in a client requires the target to be a champion, so what makes a server send this form rather than the other is not settled here. In everything observed it arrives beside a TargetUnit naming the same target.
